# WebAccessSettings

A tenant's or a namespace's web-tool settings (`/tenants/self/web-access`, `/namespaces/by-id/{id}/web-access`): the temporary partition runs' web fetches go to when their start names none.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests and responses. In a request it is called `WebAccessSettingsInput`.

## In a request

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `defaultWebDownloadPartitionId` | `uuid \| null` |  | The temporary partition web downloads go to by default. Null: none is set here (sending null clears it). |

```json
{
  "defaultWebDownloadPartitionId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f"
}
```

## In a response

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `defaultWebDownloadPartitionId` | `uuid \| null` | The temporary partition web downloads go to by default. Null: none is set here (sending null clears it). |

```json
{
  "defaultWebDownloadPartitionId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f"
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`namespaces.setWebAccess`](../api/namespaces.md) (`PUT /namespaces/by-id/{id}/web-access`)
- [`namespaces.webAccess`](../api/namespaces.md) (`GET /namespaces/by-id/{id}/web-access`)
- [`tenant.setWebAccess`](../api/tenant.md) (`PUT /tenants/self/web-access`)
- [`tenant.webAccess`](../api/tenant.md) (`GET /tenants/self/web-access`)
